🔻 Musk Mentions DOGE — Market Barely Moves

Another Dogecoin-related post from Elon Musk led to a minor +2% gain overnight.

Compared to previous pumps, this reaction highlights reduced impact.

🐶 No, Dogecoin Isn’t a Government Asset

Elon Musk confirmed that the U.S. government has no plans to adopt Dogecoin, despite a federal initiative sharing its name.

Rumors had fueled a 14% DOGE surge in February, but Musk’s statement has since led to a 3.3% dip.
